app.tagline: Seasonal water risk from NASA snow data

field.title: Your field
field.hint: Find your village, then tap the map where your field is.
field.editHint: Drag a corner to move it. Drag a dot on an edge to add a corner. Tap a corner to remove it.

q.previousHint: What grew on this field last season?
q.previous2Hint: Two seasons show which crops the soil needs a rest from.
q.plan: What do you plan to sow?
q.planHint: iSEED checks this crop and suggests options that save water or care for the soil.
q.winterWheat: Did you sow winter wheat this autumn?
q.winterWheatHint: It is sown in September–October. If yes, iSEED also checks two crops in one year.
q.source: Where does your water come from?
q.position: Where is your field on the canal?
q.normalYear: In a normal year, is there enough water?
q.soilHint: Not sure? iSEED takes the soil from the SoilGrids satellite map.
q.needField: First tap your field on the map.

plan.empty: Your planting plan is empty. Choose a field and a crop on the first tab.
plan.saved: Saved on this phone, opens without internet.

evidence.title: What the answer is based on

needSource.hargreaves: NASA POWER: crop coefficient × evapotranspiration over its season (Hargreaves)

evidence.notForecast: This is a risk signal, not a forecast.

about.intro: iSEED turns NASA data on snow, climate and heavy rain into a seasonal water-risk signal for fields in Kyrgyzstan.
about.chart: Snow water in March, km³ (NASA FLDAS)
about.missNote: Shortage years that snow does not explain are shown too: glaciers, heat or canal repairs also matter.
about.modisCheck: MODIS satellite check: agreement r = {r}; low snow in both sources: {both}.

src.fldas: NASA FLDAS — snow water per basin, 2001–2026
src.modis: NASA MODIS MOD10A1 — March snow cover, a check on FLDAS
src.imerg: NASA GPM IMERG — heavy rain by week, 2001–2025
src.power: NASA POWER — temperature, frost, rain, evapotranspiration, 1981–2025
src.modisNdvi: NASA MODIS MOD13Q1 — summer greenness of fields, 2013–2025
src.soilgrids: SoilGrids — sand and clay in the soil (not NASA)

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

warning.outside: This is outside Kyrgyzstan. iSEED works only for fields in Kyrgyzstan.
warning.water: This is water: a lake or a reservoir. A field cannot be placed here.
warning.high: Too high here: {height} m. Above {max} m there is almost no ploughland: a short cold summer and poor stony soil.
warning.locate: Could not find your location. Tap your field on the map.

agro.title: District agronomists
agro.noField: Choose your field on the map and the agronomist of that district is picked automatically.
agro.demoSource: Demo contact. The real list will come from the Ministry of Agriculture.
agro.hotlineText: If the agronomist doesn't answer, call the Ministry of Agriculture's free line for farmers.

tour.field: Mark your field here: tap it on the map, drag the corners and answer a few questions.
tour.plan: Your advice appears here: what to plant on this field and whether there will be enough water this season.
tour.agro: Your district agronomist and saved fields — get in touch and show them your field.
tour.about: Where the data comes from: NASA satellite snow data and the history of each river basin.
tour.lang: Switch the language: Kyrgyz, Russian or English. The “?” button shows this tour again.
tour.canal: Your canal: snow in the basin, how many irrigation turns to expect and who will be short of water. The message to farmers is here too.

start.title: Welcome to iSEED
start.name: Your name
start.pinHint: Remember it: your name and PIN let you sign in on another phone.

role.farmerHint: Pick a crop for your field

profile.confirm: Sign out and choose another user or role? Fields and plans on this phone are kept.

canal.title: My canal
canal.once: Fill this in once — the canal is saved and the season signal appears here.
canal.villages: Villages on the canal and their irrigated area
canal.enough: Enough water for {crop} along the whole canal
canal.notEnough: Not everyone will have enough water for {crop}
canal.water3: Expected {total} against a need of {need} for {ha} ha.
canal.snow: Snow in the basin vs normal
canal.snowDate: Computed for {month}. A risk signal, not a forecast.
canal.turnsSource: Usual turns × the season factor S from snow
canal.positionSource: Share of water that reaches this place on the canal (estimate)

message.title: Season message to farmers
message.hint: Farmers in these villages will see it: {villages}.
message.placeholder: For example: irrigation on schedule this year, 4 turns. Starts on 10 May.
message.sent: Sent {date}. Farmers registered in your villages see it at the top of their result.

errors.offline: No connection to the server. Check the internet and try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.name_taken: This name is taken. Sign in or choose another name.
errors.wrong_role: Only the other role can do this.
errors.no_basin: This place is outside Kyrgyzstan's river basins.
errors.data_missing: The data on the server is not ready yet.
errors.too_many_tries: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in 15 minutes.

position.start: At the start of the canal

check.title: Field check
check.none: No check for this place: it is outside the data grid.
check.around: Slope, greenness and soil describe about 500 m around the field, not the field alone.

slope.careful: Slope {value}° — water can wash away soil and seed.
slope.no: Slope {value}° — too steep: only hay or alfalfa.

green.good: Green in summer {greenYears} of {years} years — the land is farmed.
green.careful: Green in summer only {greenYears} of {years} years — check that this is farmland.
green.no: Bare in summer {bareYears} of {years} years — this does not look like farmland.

soil.careful: Soil: {soil} — sand dries fast, clay holds water: water it differently.

frost.good: Days to spare before the autumn frost: {days}.
frost.careful: Only {days} days to spare before the frost — sow on time.
frost.no: The crop will not finish before the frost: {days} days short.

heavyRain.good: Heavy rain in the sowing weeks in {pct} of years.
heavyRain.careful: Heavy rain in the sowing weeks in {pct} of years: it can wash out the seed.
heavyRain.no: Heavy rain in the sowing weeks in {pct} of years, on a slope: high risk of wash-out.

option.highlight: Leaves the most water for the end of the canal
option.gross: Gross income for the whole field; costs not counted. The price is a separate risk.
option.priceSource: Yields and prices: see “What the answer is based on”
option.waterLeft: Leaves {m3} m³ in the canal compared with your plan
option.waterMore: Takes {m3} m³ more water than your plan
option.rotationPlus: Good rotation after your last crop
option.rotationWarning: Same crop group again: more pests and disease

pump.heavy: If the pump stops for 10 days in July: a heavy yield loss.
pump.cut: If the pump stops for 10 days in July: one hay cut is lost.
pump.light: If the pump stops for 10 days in July: a small loss.
pump.unknown: How much a pump stop hurts this crop is not known.

option.frost: The season here is too short for this crop.
option.earnsMost: Your plan already earns the most in a dry year.

sowing.title: When to sow
sowing.best: best around {date}: less risk of heavy rain
sowing.noWindow: The sowing window for this crop is closed or too short.
sowing.heavyRain: Heavy rain in the sowing weeks: {pct} of years
sowing.flowering: Flowering around {date}; on average {days} hot days at that time.
sowing.tooHot: Flowering around {date} falls in the heat ({days} hot days) — the yield may suffer.
sowing.winter: Winter wheat is sown in autumn; the spring sowing window does not apply.

double.title: Two crops in one year
double.text: Winter wheat, then {second}. The wheat is harvested around {date}, leaving {days} days for the second crop.

season.title: Season and snow
season.snow: Snow in the {basin} basin is {level} ({pct}), computed for {month}.
season.dryYear: The dry year is the basin's average low-snow year: {pct} snow vs normal (years: {years}).
season.frostEarlier: The last spring frost now comes about {days} days earlier than in the 1980s.
season.frostSame: No clear change in the date of the last spring frost.
season.south: In the south, water depends not only on snow but also on reservoirs and interstate agreements.
